findings.text: Variant buttons clicked in the first seconds after page load do nothing (price stays R830,00, no state change); worked after reload and a few seconds wait. Likely a hydration delay, first snapshot after navigation took about 40 s.

Confirmation 'What Happens Next' text is identical for every product: 'If you bought a session, click the booking link in your email to schedule it. For programmes, your access details are in your email.' Live via Zoom / Live Retaker do not mention Zoom details; Self Study does not mention course access by email explicitly.

Select Self Study then Add to Cart within about 1 s on Program 2, then /checkout showed an empty cart (redirected to /cart, 'Your cart is empty'). Repeating with 2 s and 4 s waits worked. Add to cart gives no visible feedback, so a quick click is lost silently.
